name: Kyiv: Saint-Sophia Cathedral and Related Monastic Buildings, Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra
description: In Kyiv, Ukraine, two great Orthodox complexes stand together on the hills above the Dnipro. Saint-Sophia Cathedral, begun in the 11th century, was built to rival Constantinople's Hagia Sophia. The Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra grew from a monastery of caves into a major centre of Eastern Christianity with an early printing house. Both sites are now listed as World Heritage in Danger.
